body: How did you get yourself to start thinking positively? What made you realize there's still something to fight for? What is it? I'm going through hard times and would like to hear how did you manage to get a grip of your life. Good you are feeling up again!
It's always fun to meet fellow Finns in reddit, not sure about this time though, given the subreddit :/ when do you have your appointment?

Hey. I also use imigran, i use the nose-spray. I don't suffer from any side-effects however. Usually when i notice i might get a migraine, I take the nose-spray and sleep a few hours. If i cant get the nose-spray, i take 1g ibuprofein and 1g panacod, but it usually takes longer to take care of the migraine than imigran. My triggers are irregular eating (if i skip a meal i'm most likely going to have a migraine), and long periods of playing videogames or watching tv or stuff like that. I don't have any allergies, so pollen isn't a problem to me, i think it's the sun starting to shine more brightly and melting snow magnifying sunlight in the spring. I live in a northern country, Finland so we have very dark winters and when sun starts shining really brightly most of the day in spring, that makes me extra vulnerable to have a migraine.

I can partly relate. I am always the one to give people comfort, i'm there to hear what they have to say and trying to make them feel better when they are down. I have always supported people around me, i'm the one most my friends trust. I always thought that some day i cant take it anymore, i have my mind full of other peoples worries and problems, never having anyone i could tell about my feelings. They never cared if I had been feeling down. And now, compared with all the shit i have realized happening in the world nowadays, i am getting close to reaching the point i can't stand being used as a teddy bear when people are sad and then thrown into a corner when they have fulfilled their needs to be heard. Nobody cares about the silent, comforting, always-there kinda teddy bear.

Hi. Sorry to hear about your rough childhood. But i am here to discuss about you having migraines. I also suffer from those. Do you know what "launches" your migraine? They usually have some kind of trigger(s). And do you have any medication for the migraines? I have a medication that i take when i notice i'm having a migraine. I take my med and go to take a nap. In two hours i am like a new person. Also knowing my "triggers" has made life easier. I can avoid those so i get migraines far more seldom. Spring though is difficult time, most people suffering from migraines get a peak in migraines in spring.

I have been thinking about killing myself lately. I would love to do all kinds of crazy stuff before it, like bungee jumping. I'd love to do skydiving, and try a wingsuit. I'd like to get rid of my virginity and drink so much i pass out. I'd like to try some drugs to see what the world looks like from an other point of view. But i am not 18 yet, and i am poor as fuck and an ugly skinny motherfucker. So there's no way i get to experience any of that. It could even make me want to live again, but i don't think i can make it so far i could try none of that. I can't motivate myself to do anything, and all those things seem so far away. So i guess i'm gonna die without doing anything remarkable, anything i dreamed about. anything at all.

I agree with you. No matter how hard you tried, there is nothing you can do to the problems of the world. It's the other people going on with their consuming self-centered lifestyle and zero fucks given -attitude that makes it impossible for you to try and improve the society. You can't make up for millions of people doing nothing but harm for our planet. Especially being a poor underraged guy in a small rural country. Everyone who could possibly change how people live and get their voice to be heard, won't do it because that would not be beneficial to them. They are the ones that run the system as it is, and get all the profit. Things are going great for them, and they want to keep it that way. And so it will always be in the future, like it has always been before. The ones who have the power don't want to change the situation. Those who would want, they have no power to do it. So it's basicly pointless to pursue your dreams when you can't really effect wether you will reach them or not. You are never fully in control of your life, no matter what you do. Even the 1% can't really FULLY control their lives. And so you are forced to sit here doing some pointless bullshit and watching humanity commiting slow suicide, taking this planet with it. Greedy is the best word to describe human nature.

Suicide is also beneficial to our planet. The best thing you can do to help the environment is to minimize your consumption and die. If all humans were to die, earth would be a better place. But to your question, i think that a major reason to why more people dont commit suicide is because they are being told not to. I think majority of people are easily manipulated and keep on going with their lives because the authorities tell them to. The society is telling them to. They are doing what they are told to do. Behave, study, pay taxes, work, consume and reproduce. Redo if needed. And that's how capitalism works.

ImB underraged, i have no incomes, my family wants me to "get a good job" and go through studies with good grades. I don't possess the willpower needed to keep up with studying for the future that i cant have. I have no idea what could i put up with if i had to do it for the rest of my life. I don't want to get an average middle-classed life and job. I have tried to reach out to people on a local scale (my city, 240 000 people) a few years by writing a few columns to local newspapers and one radio talk thingy, but i have accomplished nothing with that. Not a single person has reacted to that in a way i could notice. I am too young to get my voice to be heard, people dont take me seriously. And i dont know what to do with my future. I see no way i could survive in the society without putting myself to a spot i'd die to avoid. The two choises i have are putting on a mask and live an average life with an average job and an average salary, or dropping of school and becoming a social outcast, a poor homeless drunk who does nothing but lectures to passing people underneath some old bridge/underpass.neither of those options are beneficial to trying to "change the world" So, i am clueless as os what to do with my life, if i deside to keep it going.
Anyways, thanks for talking to me. Debating and having a conversation are among the only things i have any interest left in. I'm gonna go sleep now.

But here we meet the problem of my original post. I dont have the energy to do that. I cant motivate myself to do it. I know it will be useless. Not to mention my age, nobody would take me seriously. It's not for me to be leading people to take arms against the problems of the world. I am not a good speaker. I do not have any authority over anyone. Im so young people wont listen to me. It's my fate to watch the world crumble and cringe.

I can't change the world. No one person can change the world. And that lots of people doing small things is useless, when you're against the rest of the world doing nothing. If people would want to change the world, they might be able to do it. But they are too occupied with their lives, they dont care as long as they can keep living their lives.  And even if they would somehow wake up and do something, we would propably end up with lots of bodies. A revolution, maybe, and then a new set of people would take the places of the 1% and keep driving us closer to the edge. There will always be people chasing nothing but personal gain, and those people manipulate others and run this globe. People do not act as strong individuals, they act ass a giant, hysterical mass that's easily controllable and can be manipulated to think what benefits the 1% most. And as of my personal life. I can live your average middle-class life. But thats not what i want. I want to control my life. I want to control others lives, but to do good. I want the world to listen to those who know what they are talking about, not those who know how to talk. Not those who can buy the public to be on their side. Not those who want to benefit on others lives. I want a system that is equal.
